message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, and does not apply to bases in the UAE.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "will assist the Party or Parties so attacked by taking . . . such action as it deems necessary, including the use of armed force, to restore and maintain the security of the North Atlantic area.", "reason": "The page quotes Article 5's reference to 'the North Atlantic area,' which is consistent with the note's geographic scope claim, but it does not spell out the specific territorial limitations (Europe, North America, north of the Tropic of Cancer) or mention the UAE."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, and does not apply to bases in the UAE.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: will assist the Party or Parties so attacked by taking . . . such action as it deems necessary, including the use of armed force, to restore and maintain the security of the North Atlantic area.
parsed.reason: The page quotes Article 5's reference to 'the North Atlantic area,' which is consistent with the note's geographic scope claim, but it does not spell out the specific territorial limitations (Europe, North America, north of the Tropic of Cancer) or mention the UAE.
